card.adminOnlyTag: With the tick anyone assigns new tags; without it only admins. Anyone can still assign existing ones.

card.backupsBeforeChange.other: {n} backups date from before the key change

card.confirmOnce.one: Confirm once, then load the part
card.confirmOnce.other: Confirm once, then load all {n} parts

card.convertPatienceHint: With many photos this can take a while. Please do not close the window.
card.copyByHand: Without HTTPS the browser does not release the clipboard.

card.emailOptionalHint: **Email is optional.** Without a mail account Kriterion shows invitation links and reset links for copying; with one it additionally sends them.
card.emailsDoubled: These addresses are used more than once.

card.engineCheckboxHint: Tick: available for selection. **Default**: opens when you click the search line.
card.engineCountHint: How many search engines are offered under a search line.
card.exportHint: The export writes the whole inventory unencrypted into a file — with all photos, attachments and author names.
card.exportOnlyEntries: Export and import contain only the {entryMany} — no users and no settings of Kriterion.
card.exportOversizeHint: **Export with photos: around {withPhotos}** — this can take a while, and there is no progress display ({rest}).

card.exportPartsHint.other: The export writes the whole inventory into {n} files — with all photos, attachments and author names.

card.exportPasswordHint: Before the export the password is asked for once; after that, load each part on its own.
card.exportCodeHint: Before the export the password and the two-factor code are asked for once; after that, load each part on its own.

card.forgotPasswordHint: Reset a user's password on the server:

card.getsPasswordHint: “{username}” gets a new password; every session of this user is ended.
card.grade: Stars at the point in time

mail.confirm.body:
Hello {username},

someone requested an account for “{instanceTitle}” using this address.

Please confirm the address with this link:
{link}

The link is valid for {hours} hours. It opens no account and sets no password.
An admin then reviews the request. Once approved, a second email with the password link follows.

If this was not you, there is nothing to do. The request expires by itself.

This message was sent automatically. This inbox is not monitored.
mail.confirm.subject: Confirm your address for “{instanceTitle}”
mail.hintAlways: The sender address must belong to the account. Many providers reject sending from someone else's address.
mail.hintGmail: Gmail requires two-step verification and an app password — the account password is rejected.
mail.hintGmx: GMX requires you to enable sending from other programs in the account first.
mail.hintWebDe: Web.de requires you to enable sending from other programs in the account first.
mail.invite.body:
Hello {username},

an account for “{instanceTitle}” has been created for you.

Use this link to set your own password:
{link}

The link is valid for {days} days and exactly once. From the first time you open it you have {minutes} minutes.
After that you need a new link from the admin.

Anyone with this link can get into your account — do not pass it on.

This message was sent automatically. This inbox is not monitored.
mail.invite.subject: Your account for “{instanceTitle}”
mail.noAccount: No mail account is set up.
